latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Change Background — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered video background replacement with natural language instructions.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB); automatic AI processing on cloud GPUs.
- Guided setup: auto-connects to backend, fetches and manages authentication tokens as needed.
- Provides clear user feedback during connection, editing, and export steps.
- Includes credits checking, session management, and error handling for authentication, file limits, and rate limits.
- Enables easy download of final 1080p MP4 files with replaced backgrounds—no green screen required.
